Usage: drive batch new <name> [flags]

Start a batch and make it its driver's current one.

A new batch starts with no grants, however recently one was given, and
stops the wakes of its driver's last batch, no other driver's. Start one per
drive, never after a reset: `drive --driver DRIVER batch` names yours. It starts
before the owner writes its webhook; no wake starts until then.

Arguments:
  <name>                       The batch's name, such as the date.

Flags:
      --webhook=DRIVER         Wake this chat driver by its webhook, the file
                               ~/.config/drive/webhooks/DRIVER that the owner writes; DRIVER is also
                               the driver's name. Without it, the driver waits itself.
      --rex-session=SESSION    The Rex session new sessions open in, recorded by its label and
                               started whenever it is not running; defaults to the configuration's,
                               then the one drive runs in.
      --tz=ZONE                The zone drive prints the batch's times in, such as Europe/London;
                               defaults to the configuration's, then the machine's.
      --after-wake=COMMAND     A shell command to run after each wake is posted, such as archiving
                               the chat it went to.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help                   Show context-sensitive help.
      --batch=NAME             Act in this batch, as drive prints its name, instead of the driver's
                               current one. It may stand anywhere on the line.
      --driver=NAME            Act in the batch this driver drives now; a chat driver's name is its
                               webhook's. It may stand anywhere on the line.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    refused: nothing was done; next: says what to run instead
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  3    tried and did not end as asked; the message says what did happen
  4    the session's login was rejected; next: relaunches it on another account, or says to tell the
       owner
